text: Yes, there is a tree-cover loss candidate on this property after 2020. The evidence indicates a potential loss of 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset) in 2025, detected by the Hansen GFC dataset. However, this finding is pending corroboration, meaning it hasn’t been confirmed by later observations. The loss aligns with the JRC 2020 forest reference map (98% agreement), but the cause—whether due to harvesting, fire, or other factors—is unknown. The change could involve any stand-replacing event, not necessarily deforestation or illegal activity. Further monitoring is needed to assess persistence or land-use changes.
